_: Node step 670-3 (owner 2026-11-07: «Какие тогда ещё в будущем это элемент может решать задачи? А куда это описать?»): the AREA of every service of the node — the field it is the natural home for — and the jobs it MAY GROW INTO (not built until a skill of its card says so). The main agent's map of the hands, beside roles.json: a new kind of job whose area an element owns becomes a route there, built by that element's own agent, instead of a new element. The default for every node; the main agent writes born elements' areas into data/node/areas.json (outside git, wins field by field) with npm run role -- <id> --area … --grows … or npm run create -- … --area … --grows …. Read by scripts/main-agent-cli.mjs (card, find).

auth.area: Who a person is and what they may open: accounts, sign-in, sessions, roles and access of every element.
growsInto: a journal of who opened what

data.area: The records every element keeps as table rows, and the node's own journals and settings tables.

storage.area: Files of every element kept as files: pictures, videos and documents, their stable addresses, previews and icon sets.

vectors.area: Finding texts by meaning: collections of vectors any element fills and asks.
growsInto: search by meaning over a site's pages

embeddings.area: Turning texts into vectors on this computer, with no key and no internet.

config.area: What the project is and which features it shows: its name, menus, switches, search and agent identity.
growsInto: a new feature switch for every element

design.area: How the project looks: colours, fonts, shapes, the design skill of every element.
growsInto: a brand palette taken from a logo

graph.area: Knowledge as things and links between them, shared by the elements: who and what is connected to what.
growsInto: a map of people and projects

cache.area: Fast counters and queues kept in memory for busy actions, before they reach the database.
growsInto: limits on how often someone may act

memory.area: What the person told the node to keep: phrases, photos, documents, voice notes, and reminders at a time.
growsInto: dates of the person's life and their reminders

stripe.area: Taking money through Stripe: payments, checkout, subscriptions, invoices and refunds.

root.area: The project's main public site on the root domain and the first screen where a person gives the node a task.

blocks.area: Reusable sections of pages, kept as code that the elements' agents plug in.
